categories.name: SPL22
categories.content: SPL22 is a hybrid token extension of the Solana blockchain that combines the features of both fungible and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: Time.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via time.fun.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).

categories.name: Arcade Games
categories.content: Classic-style games with simple mechanics, high replayability, and score-based progression.

categories.name: Emoji-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to emoji.

categories.name: Telegram Apps
categories.content: Applications built on the Telegram platform that integrate cryptocurrency or blockchain technology.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Pump.fun Creator
categories.content: Pump.fun creator tokens are Solana-based memecoins tied to influencers, blending streaming culture with DeFi.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: AI Meme
categories.content: Meme coins related or inspired by AI. They either leverage AI-powered agents, are created using AI tools, or derive their concept from AI technologies and trends.

categories.name: Zodiac-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to zodiac signs.

categories.name: Four.meme Ecosystem (BNB Memes)
categories.content: Four.meme Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via four.meme on BNB Chain.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: JPY Stablecoin
categories.content: A JPY stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Japanese yen.

categories.name: Liquid Staking Tokens
categories.content: Liquid staking token is a tokenized representation of staked tokens that can be traded or used in various DeFi applications.

categories.name: Robinhood Chain Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Orynth Ecosystem
categories.content: Projects launched via Orynth, designed to let users trade on the attention and interest surrounding early-stage software products and MVPs.

categories.name: Binance Megadrop
categories.content: Binance Megadrop is an airdrop program by Binance. It allows users to earn rewards by subscribing to BNB to Locked Products and completing tasks within their Binance Web3 Wallet.

categories.name: Music
categories.content: Cryptocurrency projects that are related to music is aimed at disrupting the record publishing industry. The goal is to simplify the process of tracking, collecting, and distributing song royalties to musicians in a decentralized manner. Fans are also able to directly support their favorite artists directly without going through an intermediary.
